Unlike frameworks like GSD, BMAD, or Spec-Kit that own the whole process, these skills are deliberately small, adaptable, composable, and model-agnostic, giving developers more control. He encourages hacking on them and making them your own.

Because it runs inside the IDE, developers can get AI-agent assistance while staying in the editor they already use. It is aimed at JetBrains users who want the flexibility of an open-source coding agent in their existing toolchain.

item.title: [infoq] 李飞飞首个多模态世界模型 Atlas 正式发布：从零开始预训练，几张图就能构建世界
item.description: World Labs, founded by Fei-Fei Li, unveiled Atlas, a multimodal world model pre-trained from scratch with an autoregressive diffusion Transformer natively handling text, images, video and 3D data. Given one or dozens of photos, it can reconstruct 3D scenes and render videos up to one minute at 1440p; camera pose is a first-class input, enabling controllable camera movement. Atlas is now in early access for select partners and will underpin future products.

item.title: [infoq] Diagrid Catalyst 2.0 发布，为 AI 智能体新增持久化、可验证的执行能力
item.description: On July 28, 2026, Diagrid shipped Catalyst 2.0, adding durable, verifiable execution for AI agents built with LangGraph, Google ADK, Dapr Agents, and other frameworks. Ten framework integrations are supported; model and tool calls are recorded as workflow activities so interrupted runs resume without redoing completed calls. The verification layer, inherited from Dapr 1.18, hashes and signs workflow history for validation outside the originating app — signing is off by default and requires mTLS.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] [开源分享] R20 量化系统 v7.0.0 里程碑更新版本，支持全维度自定义与每 6 小时自进化
item.description: R20 Quantum Trader is a crypto quant trading project now fully open-sourced under MIT. Its v7.0.0 rewrite exposes strategy prompts, model/API providers, and Python-based interception plugins through a visual admin panel with hot swapping, plus a six-hourly self-evolution loop. It also applies ATR-based wide stops and moves stops to breakeven after 0.8R profit to reduce stop-outs in noisy markets, which is useful for teams building AI-agent trading experiments.

item.title: [infoq] 3个月拿下 3000 star，只因我们比 MinerU 多做了这件事
item.description: Knowhere is an open-source project positioning itself as a memory layer between messy documents and AI agents; its full stack was released in May and has gathered nearly 3,000 GitHub stars in about three months. Unlike MinerU, which focuses on converting PDFs into Markdown, Knowhere reconstructs document hierarchy between parsing and vectorization so each chunk knows its section and context. This is especially relevant for teams whose RAG pipelines lose too much structural information.

item.title: [infoq] 从内部 Side Project 到 3.9 万开发者使用，Kiro Crew 创造者亲述开发幕后
item.description: Kiro Crew is an open-source, continuously running AI development workspace built on Kiro CLI by three engineers at Amazon Web Services as a side project; within six months it has exceeded 39,000 developers and nearly 500 contributors. It preserves state and progress across sessions and turns corrections and repeated workflows into Lessons and reusable Skills, coordinating multiple agents so work can keep moving until a human reviews it. Core creator Chen Bolin is scheduled to demo it on Septembe

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] casbin-gateway：支持 29 个 Agent 的桌面端管理助手，支持一键切换 LLM API、审计、权限、版本管理、多开，顺便帮你验一验中转商有没有偷换模型
item.description: Casbin Gateway is an Apache 2.0 local management console rather than another coding agent, shipped as one Go+React binary for Windows, Linux, and macOS. It scans installed agents, centralizes their configs, MCP servers, and permissions, and can sit at localhost:17000 as a proxy to audit every request, tool call, and cost. That helps developers catch model resellers that serve a different model than advertised.

item.title: [infoq] 当 Agent 走出 App：WorkBuddy 的朋友圈开始向外生长

item.title: [github_trending] blader/humanizer

Built as plain Markdown, it works with any agent supporting skills and can follow a writing sample for style.
